intro: The people behind the connections. Meet our principal investigator and the WiSyNet research community.

members.name: Umberto Spagnolini
members.title: Full Professor of Telecommunications
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Umberto Spagnolini from DEIB profile
members.bio: Umberto Spagnolini has been a Full Professor of Telecommunications at Politecnico di Milano since 2006. His research focuses on signal processing for mobile communications, radar and remote sensing.
members.credit: Biography and portrait: DEIB, Politecnico di Milano.

members.name: Maurizio Magarini
members.title: Telecommunications
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Maurizio Magarini from DEIB profile
members.bio: Maurizio Magarini is an Associate Professor at Politecnico di Milano. His research interests include signal detection, channel estimation and equalization.
members.credit: Biography and portrait: DEIB, Politecnico di Milano.

members.name: Marco Mezzavilla
members.title: Telecommunications
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Marco Mezzavilla from DEIB profile
members.bio: Marco Mezzavilla is an Associate Professor at Politecnico di Milano. His work spans next-generation radio access technologies, frontier-spectrum communications, wireless prototyping, cybersecurity and robotics.
members.credit: Biography and portrait: DEIB, Politecnico di Milano.

members.name: Matteo Oldoni
members.title: Telecommunications
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Matteo Oldoni from DEIB profile
members.bio: Matteo Oldoni is an Assistant Professor at Politecnico di Milano. His research includes microwave-filter synthesis and design, computer-aided tuning algorithms and antenna design.
members.credit: Biography and portrait: DEIB, Politecnico di Milano.

members.name: Davide Scazzoli
members.title: Assistant Professor
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Davide Scazzoli from DEIB profile
members.bio: Davide Scazzoli develops software-defined-radio testbeds and prototypes for experimental validation. His research focuses on UAV-assisted communications and sensing, transmitter localisation, joint communication and sensing, wireless sensor networks, IoT and cloud applications.
members.credit: Biography and portrait: DEIB, Politecnico di Milano.

members.name: Marouan Mizmizi
members.title: Telecommunications
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Marouan Mizmizi from DEIB profile
members.bio: Marouan Mizmizi is an Assistant Professor at Politecnico di Milano. His research covers advanced signal processing for high-mobility wireless communications, including MIMO channel estimation, mmWave and sub-THz systems, metasurfaces, and relay selection.
members.credit: Biography and portrait: DEIB, Politecnico di Milano.

members.name: Francesco Linsalata
members.title: Telecommunications
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Francesco Linsalata from DEIB profile
members.bio: Francesco Linsalata is a researcher in Telecommunications at Politecnico di Milano. His research focuses on beyond-5G and 6G wireless networks, including V2X, digital network twins, wireless localisation, UAV-enabled systems and integrated sensing and communication.
members.credit: Biography and portrait: DEIB, Politecnico di Milano.

members.name: Dario Tagliaferri
members.title: Telecommunications
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Dario Tagliaferri from DEIB profile
members.bio: Dario Tagliaferri is an Assistant Professor at Politecnico di Milano, working on signal processing for wireless communications and sensing systems, particularly for vehicular applications. His research includes integrated sensing and communication, reflecting surfaces, V2X and automotive radar sensing.
members.credit: Biography and portrait: DEIB, Politecnico di Milano.

members.name: Luca Reggiani
members.title: Telecommunications
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Luca Reggiani from DEIB profile
members.bio: Luca Reggiani is an Assistant Professor at Politecnico di Milano. His research spans information and communication theory, broadband and ultra-wideband radio systems, wireless sensor networks, and the physical layer of telecommunications.
members.credit: Biography and portrait: DEIB, Politecnico di Milano.
